import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'repro_settings')

import django
django.setup()

from django.contrib import admin
from django.contrib.admin.helpers import AdminReadonlyField
from django.forms import modelform_factory

from repro_app.models import Author, Book

custom_site = admin.AdminSite(name='custom-admin')


class AuthorAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    pass


class BookAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    readonly_fields = ('author',)


custom_site.register(Author, AuthorAdmin)
custom_site.register(Book, BookAdmin)

book_admin = BookAdmin(Book, custom_site)

author = Author(pk=1, name='Someone')
book = Book(pk=1, title='Some book', author=author)

Form = modelform_factory(Book, fields=['title'])
form = Form(instance=book)

field = AdminReadonlyField(form, 'author', is_first=True, model_admin=book_admin)
result = field.get_admin_url(Book._meta.get_field('author').remote_field, author)
print(result)
assert '/custom-admin/' in result, "BUG: URL does not use custom admin site prefix: %s" % result
print("OK")

from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import path

from repro_app.models import Author, Book

custom_site = admin.AdminSite(name='custom-admin')


class AuthorAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    pass


class BookAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):
    readonly_fields = ('author',)


custom_site.register(Author, AuthorAdmin)
custom_site.register(Book, BookAdmin)

urlpatterns = [
    path('admin/', admin.site.urls),
    path('custom-admin/', custom_site.urls),
]
